hero.title: Ship Angular interfaces from components you can own.
hero.subtitle: Copy polished, accessible Angular source into your app. Keep the speed of a component library, with the control of code that belongs to your product.

features.title: Production behavior first. Product taste next.
features.subtitle: Volt UI starts with ng-primitives for focus, overlays, ARIA and forms, then wraps it in Angular signals, Tailwind tokens, and copyable source you can reshape.
features.ownBody: The CLI copies readable standalone components directly into your application. Change every line when your product needs it.
features.behaviorBody: ng-primitives handles focus, keyboard navigation, overlays, and ARIA contracts while Volt UI handles product-ready styling.
features.systemBody: Semantic Tailwind tokens, colour presets, and style presets let one component set adapt to a complete visual language.

workflow.title: A workflow that ends in editable Angular, not vendor lock-in.
workflow.subtitle: The CLI resolves component dependencies, writes readable files, and keeps selectors consistent with the source-first workflow.
